title: Keepa product response
description: Response of the Keepa /product API. The csv array is the motivating case for schema hints: it is a fixed-layout array whose slots are identified only by position.

timestamp.title: Response timestamp
timestamp.description: When Keepa generated this response, in Unix epoch milliseconds — unlike the product-level time fields, which are in Keepa minutes.

tokensLeft.title: Tokens left
tokensLeft.description: API tokens remaining on the account after this request. Unused tokens expire after 60 minutes.

refillIn.title: Refill in
refillIn.description: Milliseconds until the next token refill.

refillRate.title: Refill rate
refillRate.description: Tokens added per minute. The bucket fills continuously, whether or not requests are being made.

tokensConsumed.title: Tokens consumed
tokensConsumed.description: Tokens this request cost — one per requested ASIN, plus 6 per fetched offer page.

tokenFlowReduction.title: Token flow reduction
tokenFlowReduction.description: How much this request temporarily lowers the refill rate, in tokens per minute. Sits alongside refillRate rather than replacing it: the effective rate is the refill rate less this reduction.

processingTimeInMs.title: Processing time
processingTimeInMs.description: Server-side time to build this response, in milliseconds.

product.title: Product
product.description: One ASIN's product data and price history. Read productType first — it determines which of these fields carry data at all.

priceTypeValues.title: Price type array
priceTypeValues.description: One value per csv price type, at the same index as the csv history array. Depending on the slot the value is a price in the locale's smallest currency unit, a sales rank, an offer count or a percentage. Real responses are often shorter than this list — always index by price type, never assume a length.

priceTypeExtremes.title: Price type extremes
priceTypeExtremes.description: One entry per csv price type, at the same index as the csv history array. Each entry is [Keepa minute, value] — when the extreme occurred and what it was — or null where the price type has no data.

prefixItems.title: When
prefixItems.description: In Keepa minutes.

prefixItems.title: Value
prefixItems.description: Price in the locale's smallest currency unit, or the rank/count for a non-price slot.

productType.title: Product type
productType.description: Evaluate this before anything else: it determines what data is available for the product.

oneOf.title: Downloadable
oneOf.description: A digital download. No price, rating or offers data; updated less often.

oneOf.title: eBook
oneOf.description: No price, rating or offers data; updated less often.

oneOf.title: Inaccessible
oneOf.description: No price, rating or offers data. Sales rank and offer counts update slowly, and some fields may be missing entirely.

oneOf.title: Invalid
oneOf.description: No current data — an invalid or deprecated ASIN, or another problem. May be temporary.

oneOf.title: Variation parent
oneOf.description: A parent ASIN; the variations field is set.

oneOf.title: com.br
oneOf.description: Brazil (no longer listed in the API docs)

oneOf.title: com.au
oneOf.description: Australia (no longer listed in the API docs)

title.title: Product title
title.description: Amazon caps titles at 75 characters outside media categories; the overflow goes to itemHighlights, so read both for the full descriptive text. May contain unescaped HTML in rare cases.

itemHighlights.title: Item highlights
itemHighlights.description: Up to 125 further characters of descriptive content — typically materials or use cases. Amazon shows it beside the title in search results.

trackingSince.title: Tracking since
trackingSince.description: First time Keepa saw this product, in Keepa minutes (minutes since 2011-01-01 UTC).

listedSince.title: Listed since
listedSince.description: When the product was first listed on Amazon, in Keepa minutes. Available for some products only; 0 or -1 when it is not.

lastUpdate.title: Last update
lastUpdate.description: Last time this product's data changed, in Keepa minutes.

lastRatingUpdate.title: Last rating update
lastRatingUpdate.description: Last time the rating or review count changed, in Keepa minutes.

lastPriceChange.title: Last price change
lastPriceChange.description: Last time any price on this product moved, in Keepa minutes.

lastEbayUpdate.title: Last eBay update
lastEbayUpdate.description: Last refresh of the eBay prices, in Keepa minutes. Negative when no matching eBay listing was found.

lastStockUpdate.title: Last stock update
lastStockUpdate.description: Most recent stock-data update across this product's offers, in Keepa minutes. Set only when the stock parameter was used and stock data was collected at least once, and not every offer is refreshed together — check each offer's own lastStockUpdate.

images.title: Images
images.description: Carousel image metadata, each entry the same image in up to two resolutions. Full path: https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/<filename>

rootCategory.title: Root category
rootCategory.description: Category node ID of the product's root category, or 0 when unknown. The value 9223372036854775807 (max long) is Keepa's placeholder '?' category, used for products listed in no or non-existent categories.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Amazon category node IDs this product is listed in. Can be empty.

categoryTree.title: Category tree
categoryTree.description: The category path in order, root first.

parentAsin.title: Parent ASIN
parentAsin.description: The variation parent's ASIN, or null when this product has no variations.

parentAsinHistory.title: Parent ASIN history
parentAsinHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, previous parent ASIN] pairs, the timestamp marking when that parent stopped applying. The current parent is in parentAsin. Absent when it never changed; tracked since 2024-03-18.

frequentlyBoughtTogether.title: Frequently bought together
frequentlyBoughtTogether.description: One or two ASINs Amazon pairs with this one. Updated only when the offers parameter was used.

bundleItems.title: Bundle items
bundleItems.description: ASINs this bundle consists of. Virtual product bundles only.

eanList.title: EANs
eanList.description: First entry is the primary EAN.

upcList.title: UPCs
upcList.description: First entry is the primary UPC.

gtinList.title: GTINs
gtinList.description: First entry is the primary GTIN.

brandStoreName.title: Brand store name
brandStoreName.description: Never set for digital products, movie rentals, product bundles, Amazon Fresh or Amazon Pantry.

brandStoreUrl.title: Brand store URL
brandStoreUrl.description: Path only — prepend the locale's Amazon domain for the full URL.

brandStoreUrlName.title: Brand store URL name
brandStoreUrlName.description: The brand segment of the store URL path, e.g. LEGO from /stores/LEGO/page/…

websiteDisplayGroup.title: Website display group
websiteDisplayGroup.description: Groups products that behave alike, which affects how sales rank is calculated and shown — variations especially.

salesRankDisplayGroup.title: Sales rank display group
salesRankDisplayGroup.description: The grouping the product's primary sales rank is based on.

type.title: Amazon product type
type.description: Amazon's own productType string, e.g. VIDEO_GAME_CONTROLLER. Unrelated to the numeric productType field.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: For books, the binding; for anything else, usually the product category.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: The design on the product, e.g. Striped.

businessDiscount.title: Business discount
businessDiscount.description: Highest business discount percentage. Often stale — it may not reflect current offers.

lastBusinessDiscountUpdate.title: Last business discount update
lastBusinessDiscountUpdate.description: In Keepa minutes. Absent when businessDiscount has no value.

material.title: Material
material.description: Primary substances the product is made of.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: The product's materials, as a list.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Packed integer date: YYYY, YYYYMM or YYYYMMDD (1978, 200301, 20150409). -1 if not available.

releaseDate.title: Release date
releaseDate.description: Same packed-integer format as publicationDate. -1 if not available.

contributors.title: Contributors
contributors.description: Pairs of [name, role] — author, actor, director and so on.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Entries of [name] or [name, type], e.g. ["English", "Original Language"].

features.title: Features
features.description: Up to 5 bullet points, each truncated at 1000 characters. May contain HTML in rare cases.

description.title: Description
description.description: Truncated at 4000 characters, and may contain HTML markup and newlines. Refreshed only when the offers parameter is used.

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: Which classification this is, e.g. proper_shipping_name.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Carousel and listing videos. Requires both the videos and offers parameters.

creator.title: Creator type
creator.description: One of Main, Customer, Seller, Influencer, Vendor, ThirdParty, Amazon, Merchant, Brand. Main marks carousel videos, which carry no duration, title or name.

aPlus.title: A+ content
aPlus.description: Enhanced listing content. Requires the aplus parameter.

fromManufacturer.title: From manufacturer
fromManufacturer.description: True when the content comes from the manufacturer or vendor.

deals.title: Deal badges
deals.description: Deal metadata for the product's buy box. Updated only when the offers parameter is used.

accessType.title: Access type
accessType.description: Who can take the deal. Keepa may add values at any time.

dealType.title: Deal type
dealType.description: The badge's kind. Keepa may add values at any time.

badge.title: Badge text
badge.description: As shown on the product page.

packageQuantity.title: Package quantity
packageQuantity.description: Items in the package. 0 or -1 if not available.

oneOf.title: No Amazon offer
oneOf.description: Amazon does not sell this product.

oneOf.title: Pre-orderable
oneOf.description: Not in stock yet; orderable in advance.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: Amazon states no availability for this offer.

oneOf.title: Backorderable
oneOf.description: Out of stock; orders are queued until it returns.

oneOf.title: Delayed
oneOf.description: Shipping is delayed — availabilityAmazonDelay carries the interval.

availabilityAmazonDelay.title: Amazon availability delay
availabilityAmazonDelay.description: Set when availabilityAmazon is 4: the delay interval in hours as [from, to]. [24, 48] is 'ships in 1-2 days'; [0, 288] is 'usually dispatched within 12 days'.

buyBoxEligibleOfferCounts.title: Buy Box eligible offer counts
buyBoxEligibleOfferCounts.description: Eight counts of offers eligible for the Buy Box, by condition and fulfilment: 0 New FBA, 1 New FBM, 2 Used FBA, 3 Used FBM, 4 Collectible FBA, 5 Collectible FBM, 6 Refurbished FBA, 7 Refurbished FBM.

competitivePriceThreshold.title: Competitive price threshold
competitivePriceThreshold.description: Price derived from other retailers, Amazon sellers excluded. An offer priced above it (with shipping) may lose Buy Box eligibility.

suggestedLowerPrice.title: Suggested lower price
suggestedLowerPrice.description: Amazon's suggested lower price including shipping, from historical selling prices, recent Buy Box-eligible prices and customer input.

ebayListingIds.title: eBay listing IDs
ebayListingIds.description: Always two entries: the lowest-priced new listing, then the lowest-priced used one. 0 or null where there is none.

isHaul.title: Amazon Haul
isHaul.description: Only basic product information is available for Haul products.

launchpad.title: Launchpad
launchpad.description: Listed in the Launchpad category, in which case salesRankReference is not available.

audienceRating.title: Audience rating
audienceRating.description: Age suitability of the media, e.g. PG-13.

isEligibleForSuperSaverShipping.title: Free shipping eligible
isEligibleForSuperSaverShipping.description: Whether the buy box qualifies for free shipping.

fbaFees.title: FBA fees
fbaFees.description: Pick & pack fee for this product, in the locale's smallest currency unit, based on its dimensions and weight at an assumed selling price — the current offer price, else the last known one, else 100.00.

variableClosingFee.title: Variable closing fee
variableClosingFee.description: In the locale's smallest currency unit. Absent when not applicable.

referralFeePercentage.title: Referral fee percentage
referralFeePercentage.description: Amazon's referral fee at the assumed selling price (see fbaFees).

variations.title: Variations
variations.description: Up to 4000 currently available variations. Requires the offers parameter for live data.

historicalVariations.title: Historical variations
historicalVariations.description: Unlisted (historical or out of stock) variation ASINs. Requires the historical-variations parameter.

coupon.title: Buy Box coupon
coupon.description: Two entries: the one-time coupon, then the Subscribe & Save first-order coupon (which applies to the initial S&S order only, not to later deliveries). Each is 0 for none, positive for an absolute discount in the locale's smallest currency unit, negative for a percentage. Always present, but only refreshed when the offers parameter is used.

couponHistory.title: Buy Box coupon history
couponHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, one-time coupon, Subscribe & Save coupon] triples, same encoding as coupon. Tracked since 2024-06-15.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Active promotions; not all can be provided. Refreshed only when the offers parameter is used.

snsBulkDiscountPercent.title: S&S bulk discount percent
snsBulkDiscountPercent.description: Bulk discount on repeat deliveries. 0 when there is none, absent when unknown.

unitValue.title: Unit value
unitValue.description: Total net quantity shipped for the ASIN — a 12-pack of 6 fl oz bottles is 72, a 2-litre bottle is 2, a pack of 12 pens is 12.

unitType.title: Unit type
unitType.description: What is being measured, e.g. fluid ounces.

eachUnitCount.title: Each unit count
eachUnitCount.description: Units in one 'each', an 'each' being the smallest component carrying its own UPC.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Pre-computed price and rank statistics. Present only when the stats parameter was used, whose value also sets 'the interval' the interval-based fields below cover (a day count, or an explicit date range). Documented here are the arrays indexed by csv price type plus the rest of the always-present core group; the Buy Box, offer and stock groups (buyBox*, retrievedOfferCount, sellerIdsLowest*, offerCount*, stock*) are returned but not labelled.

current.title: Current values
current.description: Last known value per price type. -1 where no offer was available.

avg.title: Interval average
avg.description: Weighted mean over the interval the request's stats parameter asked for. -1 where there was no offer or too little data.

avg30.title: 30-day average
avg30.description: Weighted mean over the last 30 days, independent of the requested interval.

avg90.title: 90-day average
avg90.description: Weighted mean over the last 90 days, independent of the requested interval.

avg180.title: 180-day average
avg180.description: Weighted mean over the last 180 days, independent of the requested interval.

avg365.title: 365-day average
avg365.description: Weighted mean over the last 365 days, independent of the requested interval.

atIntervalStart.title: Value at interval start
atIntervalStart.description: What each price type read at the start of the requested interval. -1 where there was no offer or too little data.

min.title: All-time low
min.description: Lowest value ever registered per price type.

max.title: All-time high
max.description: Highest value ever registered per price type.

minInInterval.title: Interval low
minInInterval.description: Lowest value per price type within the requested interval.

maxInInterval.title: Interval high
maxInInterval.description: Highest value per price type within the requested interval.

outOfStockPercentageInInterval.title: Out of stock %, interval
outOfStockPercentageInInterval.description: Percentage of the requested interval each price type had no offer: 0 never, 100 always, 25 a quarter of the time. -1 where there is too little data or the slot is not a price. Slots are named for their price type, as everywhere in this group.

outOfStockPercentage30.title: Out of stock %, 30 days
outOfStockPercentage30.description: Same measure as outOfStockPercentageInInterval, over the last 30 days.

outOfStockPercentage90.title: Out of stock %, 90 days
outOfStockPercentage90.description: Same measure as outOfStockPercentageInInterval, over the last 90 days.

outOfStockPercentage180.title: Out of stock %, 180 days
outOfStockPercentage180.description: Same measure as outOfStockPercentageInInterval, over the last 180 days.

outOfStockPercentage365.title: Out of stock %, 365 days
outOfStockPercentage365.description: Same measure as outOfStockPercentageInInterval, over the last 365 days.

lastOffersUpdate.title: Last offers update
lastOffersUpdate.description: Last refresh of the offer information, in Keepa minutes.

salesRankDrops30.title: Sales rank drops, 30 days
salesRankDrops30.description: Count of drops from a high rank number to a low one in the last 30 days — the usual proxy for sales.

totalOfferCount.title: Total offer count
totalOfferCount.description: Offers across all conditions. Per-condition counts live in the count slots of current (11 New, 12 Used, 13 Refurbished, 14 Collectible).

lightningDealInfo.title: Lightning Deal window
lightningDealInfo.description: Always [start, end] in Keepa minutes, or null if the product never had a Lightning Deal. An upcoming deal has end -1; a live deal has a past start and a future end; a finished one has both in the past.

prefixItems.title: Start
prefixItems.description: In Keepa minutes, UTC.

prefixItems.title: End
prefixItems.description: In Keepa minutes, UTC. -1 for an announced deal that has not started.

salesRankReference.title: Sales rank reference
salesRankReference.description: Category node ID the main sales rank belongs to. -1 when unavailable, -2 when the product is in Launchpad.

salesRankReferenceHistory.title: Sales rank reference history
salesRankReferenceHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, category node ID] pairs — what the historical sales ranks in csv were measured against. -1 unavailable, -2 Launchpad.

salesRanks.title: Sales rank histories
salesRanks.description: One entry per category: the key is the category ID, the value a flat [Keepa minute, rank] series.

lastSoldUpdate.title: Last sold update
lastSoldUpdate.description: Last refresh of monthlySold, in Keepa minutes.

monthlySold.title: Monthly sold
monthlySold.description: Amazon's 'bought past month' figure — a bracketed floor, not an estimate (1000 means at least 1000). Variation-specific, and unset for most ASINs.

monthlySoldHistory.title: Monthly sold history
monthlySoldHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, monthlySold] pairs.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Variation-specific rating and review count histories. Requires the rating parameter, and cannot be forced to update; for non-variation-specific figures use the csv RATING and COUNT_REVIEWS entries. The ratingCount history stopped updating on 2025-04-09, when Amazon removed the data point.

offers.title: Marketplace offers
offers.description: Returned only when the request's offers parameter is used. Keepa retrieves the best offers as sorted by Amazon; if a product has more offers than requested, the rest are absent. The list mixes live and historic offers — check lastSeen, or use liveOffersOrder.

liveOffersOrder.title: Live offer order
liveOffersOrder.description: Positions in the offers array of the currently live offers, in Amazon's order — the documented alternative to filtering on each offer's lastSeen yourself. A repeated index marks a higher-priced duplicate Keepa dropped, pointing at the cheaper offer it kept.

buyBoxSellerIdHistory.title: Buy Box seller history
buyBoxSellerIdHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, seller ID] pairs. Seller ID -1 means the Buy Box was suppressed; -2 means the seller could not be identified or the product was out of stock. Requires the offers or buybox parameter.

buyBoxUsedHistory.title: Used Buy Box history
buyBoxUsedHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, seller ID, condition, isFBA] quadruples, all as strings. Condition is 2 Like New, 3 Very Good, 4 Good, 5 Acceptable; isFBA is 1 or 0. An empty seller ID means no offer qualified. Requires the offers or buybox parameter.

isRedirectASIN.title: Redirected ASIN
isRedirectASIN.description: Amazon redirects this ASIN to another — typically an unavailable variation pointing at an available one. Valid only when the offers parameter was used.

isSNS.title: Subscribe & Save
isSNS.description: The Buy Box is available for Subscribe & Save.

offersSuccessful.title: Offers retrieved
offersSuccessful.description: Whether fresh offer information could be fetched. A product with no marketplace offers at all still returns true — there was simply no offer page to fetch. Valid only when the offers parameter was used.

csv.title: Price and rank history
csv.description: One entry per data type, indexed by position; null where that history does not exist. Most are [Keepa minute, value] pairs, but the *_SHIPPING types are [Keepa minute, price, shipping] triples. Prices are in the locale's smallest currency unit; -1 means 'no offer in that interval'. Entries are appended only when the value changes, not on every update. Keepa may append new types without notice, so never assume a fixed length.

prefixItems.title: Amazon price
prefixItems.description: Price of the Amazon offer itself.

prefixItems.title: New price
prefixItems.description: Lowest marketplace New price, Amazon included. Entries before 2026-02-23 are the lowest listing price; from that date they are the lowest landing price (listing price plus shipping).

prefixItems.title: Used price
prefixItems.description: Lowest marketplace Used price. Same listing/landing price change on 2026-02-23 as the New price.

prefixItems.title: Sales rank
prefixItems.description: Sales rank in the product's root category. Not every product has one — variations usually do not.

prefixItems.title: List price
prefixItems.description: Manufacturer's list price (MSRP).

prefixItems.title: Collectible price
prefixItems.description: Lowest collectible-condition price. Same listing/landing price change on 2026-02-23 as the New price.

prefixItems.title: Refurbished price
prefixItems.description: Lowest refurbished-condition price. Same listing/landing price change on 2026-02-23 as the New price.

prefixItems.title: New, FBM
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Lowest third-party New price from a merchant-fulfilled offer, Amazon excluded, shipping included. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Lightning deal price
prefixItems.description: Price during a Lightning Deal. A live deal shows as a final entry with a future date and price -1; the same shape with no active deal announces an upcoming one. Use the stats object's current price to sidestep this.

prefixItems.title: Warehouse price
prefixItems.description: Lowest Amazon Warehouse (used) price. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: New, FBA
prefixItems.description: Lowest third-party New price fulfilled by Amazon, excluding Amazon and Warehouse. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: New offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of marketplace merchants selling this as new.

prefixItems.title: Used offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of used offers.

prefixItems.title: Refurbished offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of refurbished offers.

prefixItems.title: Collectible offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of collectible offers.

prefixItems.title: Extra info updates
prefixItems.description: When Keepa last refreshed the offers-parameter data (offers, aPlus, videos, isSNS, isRedirectASIN, and the csv types that require offers). Those refresh rarely, so this is how you tell 'unchanged' from 'not looked at'. The magnitude is how many offers were fetched; a negative value means more existed than were fetched.

prefixItems.title: Rating
prefixItems.description: Average review rating, times 10 (45 = 4.5 stars). Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Review count
prefixItems.description: Number of customer reviews. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Buy Box price
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. New Buy Box price including shipping; -1 when nothing qualified or the Buy Box was a used offer. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Used, like new
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Used, very good
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Used, good
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Used, acceptable
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, like new
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, very good
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, good
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, acceptable
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Refurbished, shipping included
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: eBay new
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Lowest new price on the matching eBay locale. eBay listings often carry wrong product codes, so treat these prices with caution; they also update on a different schedule to Amazon's.

prefixItems.title: eBay used
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Lowest used price on the matching eBay locale, with the same caveats as eBay new.

prefixItems.title: Trade-in value
prefixItems.description: Amazon trade-in value. Not available in every locale.

prefixItems.title: Rent (retired)
prefixItems.description: Never populated. The slot is kept so the positions after it line up.

prefixItems.title: Used Buy Box price
prefixItems.description: [time, price, shipping] triples. Used Buy Box price in any sub-condition; -1 when no offer qualified. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: Prime exclusive price
prefixItems.description: Lowest Prime exclusive New offer. Requires the offers parameter.

prefixItems.title: New FBA offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of New offers fulfilled by Amazon, the Amazon offer included. Added March 2026.

prefixItems.title: New FBM offer count
prefixItems.description: Number of merchant-fulfilled New offers. Added March 2026.

offer.title: Marketplace offer
offer.description: One marketplace offer: its seller, condition, Prime/FBA flags, coupons, and price/shipping/stock history. Offers are often outdated — the same offer keeps its offerId across requests, but the order changes and coverage has gaps.

offerId.title: Offer ID
offerId.description: Unique within this product, and stable across requests, so the same offer can be tracked over time. Unrelated to Amazon's own offer IDs, which are user-specific and short-lived.

lastSeen.title: Last seen
lastSeen.description: Last time this offer was seen and updated, in Keepa minutes. Check this before treating an offer as live.

sellerId.title: Seller ID
sellerId.description: Merchant's seller ID, e.g. A2L77EE7U53NWQ for Amazon.com Warehouse Deals.

isPrime.title: Prime
isPrime.description: Available via Prime shipping. Keepa cannot reliably identify Seller Fulfilled Prime.

isMAP.title: MAP restricted
isMAP.description: Price is hidden on Amazon under a minimum-advertised-price restriction. The price and shipping cost are still present here.

isShippable.title: Shippable
isShippable.description: Currently shippable. If not, it may be temporarily out of stock, or a pre-order.

isWarehouseDeal.title: Warehouse Deal
isWarehouseDeal.description: The offer is an Amazon Warehouse Deal.

isAmazon.title: Sold by Amazon
isAmazon.description: The seller is Amazon itself. Warehouse Deals, and other accounts Amazon runs under a different name, do not count.

isPrimeExcl.title: Prime exclusive
isPrimeExcl.description: This offer has a discounted Prime exclusive price.

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.description: One-time coupon on this offer, absent if there is none. Positive is an absolute discount in the locale's smallest currency unit (500 = $5 off); negative is a percentage (-15 = 15% off).

couponHistory.title: Coupon history
couponHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, coupon] pairs, same coupon encoding as the coupon field.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Open Box conditions are coded as Used conditions.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: Keepa could not determine the condition.

conditionComment.title: Condition comment
conditionComment.description: The seller's free-text description of the condition. Absent if unavailable.

minOrderQty.title: Minimum order quantity
minOrderQty.description: Only present when the offer sets one.

lastStockUpdate.title: Last stock update
lastStockUpdate.description: Most recent update of this offer's stock data, in Keepa minutes.

offerCSV.title: Price and shipping history
offerCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, price, shipping cost] triples — the last three entries are the current values. Price and shipping are in the locale's smallest currency unit (cents, yen). Shipping 0 means free shipping; -1 means not shippable or unspecified shipping; -2 in either slot means the value could not be determined.

stockCSV.title: Stock history
stockCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, stock] pairs. Present only when the request used the stock parameter, and not guaranteed to be available at all. Keepa's best attempt at the quantity — it can be wrong, for instance where per-customer limits apply.

primeExclCSV.title: Prime exclusive price history
primeExclCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, price] pairs, in the locale's smallest currency unit. A price of -1, or a null field, means no Prime exclusive price. Such an offer is only orderable with an active Prime subscription.

offerDuplicates.title: Duplicate offers
offerDuplicates.description: Near-identical offers from the same seller, in the same condition and shipping type, that were dropped from the offers list because they were not the cheapest. Absent if there are none.

price.title: Price
price.description: In the locale's smallest currency unit.

shipping.title: Shipping cost
shipping.description: In the locale's smallest currency unit.
